info.title: OneTrace.pro API
info.description: Public API v1: event ingestion (write keys) and project management (secret keys with permissions). Errors are `{"message": "..."}`; validation errors add `errors` by field path. Lists use cursor pagination (`limit` 1-200, `cursor` from `next_cursor`). POST requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header: a repeat with the same key and body returns the stored response for 24 hours. Rate limits: 6000 requests/min per write key, 1200 requests/min per secret key (`429`). Error messages follow `Accept-Language` (en, ru, de, es, fr, it, pt, tr, uz, zh), otherwise the platform default language.

Dynamic segments are computed asynchronously; poll `status`. Rules use the same DSL as the segment builder (docs/architecture/segmentation.md).

Requires key permission(s): `segments.write`.

post.summary: Create a journey draft
post.description:
The draft may be incomplete; it is validated on publish. Graph and entry use the editor format (docs/architecture/journeys.md).

Requires key permission(s): `journeys.write`.

get.summary: Get a journey with its draft and published version

post.summary: Validate the draft without publishing
post.description:
422 lists errors by path, e.g. `graph.nodes.2.data.template_id`.

Requires key permission(s): `journeys.read`.

post.summary: Publish the draft as a new version
post.description:
First publish activates the journey and counts towards the plan's active journeys limit.

Requires key permission(s): `journeys.publish`.

post.summary: Pause: no new entries, participants stay
post.description:
Body `{"exit_all": true}` also exits all participants. Only active journeys.

Requires key permission(s): `journeys.publish`.

post.summary: Resume a paused journey
post.description:
Counts towards the active journeys limit.

Requires key permission(s): `journeys.publish`.

post.summary: Archive: all participants exit

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

200.description: Not enrolled (repeat key, re-entry policy, audience or limit)

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

post.summary: Create a campaign draft
post.description:
The draft may be incomplete; readiness is checked on schedule.

Requires key permission(s): `campaigns.write`.

patch.description:
Only draft, scheduled or paused campaigns; a scheduled campaign is re-checked and its next run recomputed.

Requires key permission(s): `campaigns.write`.

integration_id.description: Channel integration; the template of every variant must belong to its channel.

delete.description:
Fails with 422 while scheduled or sending: cancel it first.

Requires key permission(s): `campaigns.write`.

get.summary: Campaign report: last runs with per-variant stats

post.summary: Schedule (or launch) a campaign
post.description:
Draft or paused campaign without a paused run. Checks readiness (channel, templates, audience, goal, schedule); `now` starts within a minute.

Requires key permission(s): `campaigns.send`.

post.summary: Pause a campaign
post.description:
The current run stops queueing messages; next runs do not start.

Requires key permission(s): `campaigns.send`.

post.summary: Resume a paused campaign
post.description:
A paused run continues; otherwise the campaign is scheduled again.

Requires key permission(s): `campaigns.send`.

post.summary: Cancel a campaign
post.description:
Unsent recipients of the current run do not get the message; recurring runs stop.

Requires key permission(s): `campaigns.send`.

get.summary: Website widget configured in the admin panel
get.description: Write key (tracker renders <div data-cdp-widget="{uid}">, ADR-048). Returns the widget settings and its products in one request; a paused widget returns no items. Personal recommendations use the profile of `anonymousId` only.

parameters.name: item[]
parameters.description: Context product ids (data-item): page product or cart items.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (data-category); overrides the widget category.

403.description: Request origin is not one of the key website domains

404.description: Widget not found in the project

writeKey.description: `cdp_wk_…`: ingestion only. Also accepted as Basic auth user or `writeKey` body field.

secretKey.description: `cdp_sk_…`: server-side only, permissions chosen when the key is created.

IdentityValue.name: value
IdentityValue.description: Normalized like at ingestion (lower-case email, E.164 phone).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Repeat-safe retries: same key and body return the stored response (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); a different body gives 422; a request still in progress gives 409.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the required permission or the brand is suspended

NotFound.description: Not found in the key's project

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit or monthly event quota exceeded

Error.description: The request cannot be applied in the current state

segment_ids.description: Members of any of these segments get the campaign.

exclude_segment_ids.description: Members of these segments are excluded.

template_id.description: Message template of the campaign channel.

percent.description: Share of the audience (or of the A/B test share); all variants add up to 100.

CampaignAb.description: A/B test: `test_percent` of the audience is split between variants; after `wait` the rest gets the winner by `metric`.

CampaignSchedule.description: Times are wall-clock in the project time zone; with `local_time` — in each recipient's `timezone` trait.

CampaignGoal.description: Conversion: the event from the recipient within the window after sending.

integration_id.description: Channel integration; the template of every variant must belong to its channel.

converted.description: Recipients with the goal event in the window; null without a goal.

ab_result.description: Test result saved when the A/B winner was picked.

AbStats.description: Significance of the difference between variants (docs/architecture/analytics.md#значимость-ab); null with one variant.

winner.description: Set only when the best variant is significantly better than every other one.

p_value.description: Holm-adjusted p-value against the best variant

image.description: JPEG up to image_width via imgproxy; without imgproxy — a direct link (CDN copy or feed URL).

image_original.description: Direct link: the platform CDN copy if the feed mirrors images, otherwise the feed URL.

srcset.description: Variants for <picture>: AVIF and WebP srcset (240–960 px); null without imgproxy.

id.description: Product id on the site: product_id in events.
